title: Full/Closed split in try_send match arms preserves drop-connection semantics while adding observability
description: The old if-is_err-break collapsed both Full (stalled client) and Closed (clean disconnect) into a silent break. The new match distinguishes them: Full gets a tracing::warn with the client identifier; Closed is a silent break. This is the correct design — a stalled client is an operator-actionable event (check SSE consumer health), a clean disconnect is not. A future contributor might suggest 'simplifying' the match back to is_err() for brevity; that reverts the observability. The Full+warn path is the whole point of this batch and should be defended.
